fault_streetlight.findings: Outstanding accuracy. Streetlight structures provide stark geometric and contrast signals, making detection near-perfect across day and night conditions.
fault_streetlight.recommendation: Deploy directly to production with high confidence threshold (conf >= 0.50).

open_manhole.findings: High precision (79.1% val, 67.8% test) ensures low false alarm rate. Test mAP50 reached 78.7%. Circular rim and dark cavity provide strong visual cues. Lower recall (55%) means partially covered or shadowed manholes are occasionally missed.
open_manhole.recommendation: Use safety-biased operating threshold (conf = 0.20-0.25) to boost recall and prioritize urgent human review.

garbage_litter.findings: Handles the largest and most cluttered class (21,657 val instances, 5,111 test instances) with stable 56-58% mAP and 66% precision. False negatives occur in dense, diffuse heaps where individual bags blur together.
garbage_litter.recommendation: Standard operational threshold (conf = 0.35) is well-suited for automated sanitary worker dispatch.

surface_erosion.findings: Strong recall (64.4% val, 80.0% test) ensures erosion patches are identified, but lower precision (38.9%) causes occasional confusion with adjacent asphalt discoloration and coarse gravel.
surface_erosion.recommendation: Merge or cluster adjacent erosion boxes with spatial NMS before reporting.

pothole.findings: Core civic issue shows balanced 55% precision and 50% recall. Difficulties arise with shallow puddles inside potholes (confused with stagnant water) and tree canopy shadows.
pothole.recommendation: Operating threshold of conf = 0.30 provides optimal trade-off for civic reporting.

road_crack.findings: Hairline cracks occupy only 2-5 pixels in width at 640x640 resolution. Standard anchor-free downsampling (stride 8, 16, 32) loses fine linear features, leading to low mAP.
road_crack.recommendation: In future iterations (Notebook 05+), test tiled inference (SAHI) or higher input resolution (imgsz=800 or 1024) to preserve thin edges.

stagnant_water.findings: High precision (51.5%) but severe recall deficiency (3.9% val, 8.0% test). In non-reflective conditions, still water is visually indistinguishable from dry dark asphalt without specular reflections or sky glare.
stagnant_water.recommendation: Supplement training with rainy/wet road datasets, apply contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE), and evaluate color jitter augmentations.
